name: HumidorMaintenanceLog
description: A single maintenance event recorded for a humidor, such as a humidity check, aid replacement, or cleaning.

humidor_id.description: ID of the HumidorLocation this event belongs to

humidor_name.description: Snapshot of the humidor name at time of logging

humidity_reading.description: Optional humidity reading recorded during this event (% RH)

temperature_reading.description: Optional temperature reading recorded during this event (°F)

aid_type.description: Type of humidity aid involved in this event (for replacement events)

aid_brand.description: Brand of humidity aid involved in this event

notes.description: Optional free-text notes about this maintenance event

created_by.description: Email of the user who created this record

created_date.description: ISO timestamp when this record was created
